content: Melvin-Koushki notes that Dawlatshāh Samarqandī identifies Ibn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī as the two most prominent intellectuals of Shahrukhid Iran and states that Ibn Turka's writings are famous throughout the world.
refers_to_primary: Dawlatshāh Samarqandī, Tazkirat al-Shuʿarā, p.379 (per MK fn.108)
